1. **"Fix possible buffer overflow on corrupted images"** (f933cbe) - This is likely the fix for the vulnerability!
2. **"TGA: fix Undefined-shift"** (ebf77cc) - Another fix
3. **"TGA: ignoring large metadata on dev area"** (326e560) - Another fix

Let me look at the "Fix possible buffer overflow on corrupted images" commit:
